why: ECH can't hide a non-admitted domain behind an admitted IP: a ClientHello carrying an Encrypted Client Hello extension, even on an IP admitted for the outer domain api.allowed.example, is refused at the egress gateway (TLS-1) — an encrypted inner name could be a non-admitted domain, so ECH is refused regardless of the outer-domain admission (doc 06 §3c ECH/SVCB suppression; DNS-4 + TLS-1)
